text.text_excerpt: The coolest part of eating at Cavan is definitely the house itself. All of the details in the molding down to the pieces of exposed brick are meticulously planned and look gorgeous. It makes for a really cool setting to eat a modern meal. The upstairs is very different from the downstairs and has more of a speakeasy vibe with the tin ceiling. We started our night with a couple of drinks at the upstairs bar while we waiting for our reservation to open. The drinks were $9 (I've only seen comparable drinks/prices at Bakery Bar) and were a step above a regular mixed drink. We went downstairs for dinner and ordered the tuna carpaccio, raw oysters, seared scallops with jalapeño grits, and an an...

Incredible dinner with my family at Cavan to celebrate my younger sisters engagement. The mansion itself is beautiful and classically appointed, and it feels exactly like you want a fancy restaurant in New Orleans to feel. The menu changes frequently, as do the cocktails. We had a private dining room, which was amazingly special. Everything we ate was sumptuous and fabulous, and the service was top notch. I followed a recommendation and went with the she-crab soup to start and the NY strip, which was perfectly prepared with green tomato chimichurri, lyonnaise potatoes, and blue cheese. I thought I was too full for dessert, but man alive was I wrong, because the carrot cake was killer deli...

This place is simply amazing. Ambiance 5/5 - so unique. Food 5/5 - craving it already. Service 5/5 - very friendly. We made reservations for our party of 5 so we had no problem being seated. For appetizers we ordered the hush puppies, oyster cocktail and fried oyster toast. I loved the fried oyster toast- it is a must try. For dinner I ordered the gumbo and the shrimp and grits. The gumbo was good but not my favorite. The shrimp and grits were so delicious!!! Best shrimp and grits I've ever had. The grits were so flavorful and creamy, and there were plenty of shrimp.
